title: Balance-edge fade to the fixed POC
source: The balance drawings show both edge bands and rotations toward POC. Fixed prior value is an explicit research construction; the source does not publish the G-default distances or band thickness. MAMT p.5 says most excursions return, while p.9 calls the general return about one in five: that statistical claim has an internal denominator/direction conflict.
finding: The fresh producer calls both edge rejection helpers, but discards inside-balance eligibility and POC reach. The helper evaluates acceptance over the whole AM, and its POC search starts at the window beginning and measures 60 minutes from touch rather than confirmed rejection. July 10 is a valid named fade example; that does not validate the omitted conditions on other days. A fresh January2 check returns vah_reject=1 and inside=0, directly exposing the ignored eligibility. July10 rejection is known09:33 and a later POC touch exists in the09:33 bar.
fix: Freeze the prior RTH trade profile at its actual session close: one-tick grid, volume POC, 70% VA with documented tie handling. Preserve the source balance-band object separately from the named VA-edge implementation. Validate the exact profile feed and bin vector against retained POC/VA/volume; the five checked Quantpad profiles reproduce the stored values. Do not infer a mismatch from a thin histogram bar hidden by rendering.

Scan each edge visit in time order. Before the touch, require price in balance and no already confirmed 30-minute acceptance outside. Do not let acceptance later in the day invalidate an earlier eligible fade. Apply the named two-tick touch and 0.5×VA-height close reversal within 15 minutes, with completion timestamps. Preserve the exact fractional rejection distance or round the required executable threshold outward so an at-least-half-width test cannot pass one tick too early. A whole-session day-type label may be used for retrospective strata only; it is not a morning eligibility input.

Starting at the confirmed rejection, find the first POC overlap in the following 60 minutes. Keep setup, rejection, POC target and later invalidation fields separate; an earlier POC touch cannot prevent a later valid one or count as the target.

Report edge-fade rejection and POC outcome conditional on eligible edge episodes. Keep the general excursion-return statistic separate and source-stopped until the p.5/p.9 conflict is resolved. Remove the unconditional reject-only pass label.
acceptance: July10,2026 VAL29823 rejection is known09:33 and a subsequent POC29900 overlap occurs in09:33. January28 opens aboveVAH26100 and has no AM edge fade. January2’s current positive has inside=0 and cannot certify eligible balance fading.
A POC visit before rejection followed by no later visit is not a target success. A later valid visit must remain discoverable.
An outside acceptance at 14:00 cannot alter a fade known at 10:00.
definition_decision: MAMT p.5 and p.9 disagree on the general failed-auction frequency. That statistical claim cannot be certified by inspecting an individual edge-fade chart.

title: Ledge break, retest and continuation
source: A ledge is the edge of a volume shelf. The figures show multiple fixed ledges around POC; they do not define a universal median-volume threshold. Prior VA boundaries alone are a different named level set.
finding: The retained recipe cache lacks a02_ledge_hold on 638 dates, allowing the old tape print-near-VA flag to supply the score. Fresh assembly differs on 371 of 668 rows. Fresh code calls the break/retest helper on both VA edges, but passes the same entire AM as break and retest windows, allowing a touch before hold confirmation. No source shelf or next node is selected.
fix: Invalidate caches missing any required recipe key even if recipe_rev matches. Record producer identity per joined field, rebuild the affected table in a future implementation task and remove silent fallback to a differently defined tape flag.

Build the named shelf detector on a complete fixed prior price grid: maximal adjacent runs at or above the declared median, with first/last prices as ledges. Store shelf bounds, height and both ledges; call the VA fallback a distinct variant. The current profile_nodes walks sorted occupied keys without checking tick adjacency. Fill missing interior rows before runs; publish the median population and an explicit degenerate-zero-median policy rather than treating every empty row as a shelf.

For each ledge and side, require a close beyond it followed by the full 30-minute outside hold. Begin the retest search after hold completion; require approach from outside, then the named rejection in the break direction and no close back inside over the specified confirmation window.

Choose the next external node at setup time, using an explicit ordered candidate list. Score retest confirmation and post-confirmation reach by 16:00 separately, conditional on eligible held breaks. Any next target that is a session high/low must be unvisited at selection and retire on its first revisit, independently by side, under the user requirement. Shelf/POC retest lifecycles remain their own sourced objects.
acceptance: July 10, 2026 retained true must be identified as old print proximity; both fresh break/retest flags are false.
January 28 holds above VAH but never retests it in AM; it must remain false.
A touch before the 30-minute hold ends cannot satisfy the retest. A median-derived shelf must retain zero-bin gaps rather than joining nonadjacent prices.

title: Re-entry, inside hold and opposite-edge traverse
source: The loose 80% statement conditions the traverse on re-entry and acceptance inside prior value. The 30-minute hold and 16:00 horizon are named defaults, distinct from the two-period strict rule. AMT1 also conditions the trade on order-flow confirmation; keep a price-only traverse statistic separate when tape cannot be trusted.
finding: The current helper handles outside opens only. Its held-inside check enforces one boundary, so price can exit the far side immediately and still pass. Target timing is compared with re-entry, not hold completion, and only the first whole-window target touch is considered. The scorer divides by all eligible days instead of held re-entries.
fix: Create eligible excursions from either an outside open or a subsequently confirmed outside break. Store the same edge and side through re-entry; do not substitute the six-to-nine path class.

On a complete close back inside, require every confirming close to satisfy VAL < close < VAH for the entire named 30-minute hold. A break through either boundary cancels this acceptance candidate; restart only on a new valid episode. Measure the hold from the re-entry close’s completion and require uninterrupted market-open coverage; an endpoint observation alone cannot prove the intervening30 minutes.

After hold confirmation, scan for an opposite-edge two-tick overlap before 16:00, stopping on the defined invalidation. Earlier opposite-edge touches are path history, not a confirmed-setup outcome. Store both timestamps.

Report accepted re-entry count as the denominator and far-edge reach count as numerator; retain excluded, censored and ambiguous observations separately. Include both entry sides and both origin types.
acceptance: January2,2026 first inside close is known10:13; VAL25537.50 is reached10:20 and a close below it is known10:22. The hypothetical30-minute confirmation10:43 never exists; traverse=true is not a valid held re-entry.

February12,2026 first inside close is known09:45, the complete both-boundary hold finishes10:15 and the first later VAL25141.75 overlap is10:38. Preserve those ordered timestamps as the named positive.
An inside open followed by a held breakout and genuine re-entry is eligible; the current open-only branch must not discard it.

title: Strict two-period 80% rule
source: The source requires an outside open and two consecutive 30-minute periods back inside value before a complete traverse. It does not restrict those periods to A and B or specify whether closes or complete ranges must be inside.
finding: amt_80pct currently tests outside open and the 09:59/10:29 one-minute closes. It never checks the target. July 22 is a direct false success interpretation: both closes are inside, but RTH high 29342.25 does not reach VAH 29361.75.
fix: Keep the source period-inside definition unresolved for faithful certification. Implement only separately named close-inside and full-range-inside readings after the choice is documented; do not silently treat A/B as the only eligible pair.

Resample on the 09:30 exchange clock into complete 30-minute periods. Search consecutive qualifying pairs after an outside open, with known_at at the second period end. The close-only variant accepts inclusive[VAL,VAH] period closes as currently declared; the full-range variant requires every traded price/range inside. Preserve that equality policy rather than silently borrowing A03’s strict interior rule.

Freeze the entry edge and opposite target. Starting after pair completion, measure two-tick overlap of the opposite VA edge by the actual RTH close. A target reached before the pair finishes is not a later traverse.

Rename the existing flag as a setup-eligibility observation. Publish traverse probability conditional on qualifying pairs, including n=0 if none exist, with one stated unit per day or per independent episode.

A C/D pair can qualify when A/B do not. A missing minute prevents a complete period rather than shifting a row-index close.
Closes inside with wicks outside must differ between the two named readings.

title: POC repeated failure versus through-and-retest
source: The POC tell is a sequence: repeated failed visits imply chop; an aggressive push through followed by a holding retest supports the far edge. POC is a fixed reference, and the source does not define the numeric visit reset or hold duration.
finding: a05_poc_tell counts touching minutes rather than independent visits, infers direction from the first AM close, and accepts held-through OR retest-reject. Near/far targets use the entire window, including prices before the signal. Only the chop flag is scored.
fix: Start from a valid inside-open or A03 re-entry event. Fix the prior POC and entry side at that point. Define an explicit reset outside the touch band before a new visit may count; expose the reset as a named parameter. This source deliberately permits repeated POC tests; the user’s first-visit retirement of session highs/lows must not silently erase this distinct POC-tell object.

For chop, require at least two distinct failed visits with no confirmed through-and-hold by the second failure. For traverse, require close-through, a later retest from the new side, and rejection in that direction; keep held-through-only as a separate observation.
Set known_at to the second failure or retest confirmation. Search near and far targets only afterward through 16:00, preserving invalidation and same-bar ambiguity.
Report the two signal classes and their subsequent near/far outcomes separately. Add an aggression filter only with trustworthy tape and a published or clearly named definition.
acceptance: July10 has27 touching minutes but only12 contiguous touch runs. Even12 is a diagnostic lower-level grouping, not12 author-defined failed attempts. A declared reset and failure confirmation are still necessary.
January 28 has zero POC 26090 visits and remains a negative.
Two adjacent touch bars in one visit count once; a far-edge touch before the second failure does not count as its outcome.

title: Failed auction at an older external balance POC
source: MAMT p.9 explicitly targets established VAH after rejecting an older POC from above, and VAL in the mirror. The p.11 accepted example labels vah = target. FORMULAS repeats the far-boundary procedure but its fixture stops at near VAL; that fixture conflicts with the source. The older POC belongs to a distinct prior balance.
finding: Retained a06_naked_poc comes from a tape check against today’s final RTH POC, tested for absence overnight; this is retrospective. Fresh assembly changes 311 of 668 rows, but fresh recipe code passes the established balance’s own POC as older_poc. The helper lacks ordered break/tag windows and targets the near boundary.
fix: Repair schema validation as in A02. Build a chronological ledger of completed older balance profiles and naked POCs, with their first subsequent trade-through retirement times. Never use the current day’s final RTH POC to define a morning setup. Naked-POC retirement is its own sourced trade-through rule, separate from the user’s exact first-visit session-high/low lifecycle. Store both the drawn line’s visibility and the originating first-tag episode so a confirmation after the tag is not discarded.

At the established-balance break, choose an eligible older POC outside that balance on the break side. Preserve its originating profile and age. A POC inside the same established VA cannot satisfy the older-external-balance leg.

Require break confirmation, then the older POC tag, then the named five-minute instant-rejection condition in order. Separate the deep-entry-but-eventually-rejected reading from the instant variant. Use only post-tag prices to determine the rejection.

Set the downside-break target to established VAH and the upside-break target to established VAL, with post-rejection reach by 16:00. Correct the formula fixture to reach the actual far target. Publish setup probability and conditional target success separately.
acceptance: July 10, 2026 current helpers return false; the retained true is not an older-POC setup. January 28 is also not such a setup.
For VAL 100, VAH 120 and older POC 92, a post-rejection high of 100 is not the source target success; a later reach of 120 is.
Changing afternoon volume must not move an older POC or alter its overnight naked status.

title: Confirmed boundary break and later holding retest
source: The source drawings show a break followed by a separate return and continuation. IB is one named boundary family; the illustrated balance and shelf edges remain distinct. The numerical 30-minute hold and G-default are research choices. WIC’s native example uses a29730–29740 balance band with renewed downside toward29580, plus a separate29830–29840 upper boundary. TRAP also requires an intraday break/retest and renewed selling; these are not arbitrary first-hour H/L lines. RTVP’s roughly68% value convention remains separate from the named70% prior-RTH variant.
finding: The producer covers both IB edges but passes the entire post-IB window to both break and retest checks. It can count the initial boundary contact as a later retest. June 9 passes despite no return to IB low 29365 after the outside hold completes. Next value, HTF filter and other source boundaries are omitted. A separate January 30, 2026 sequence breaks IB low 25790.75 at 11:55, completes the named hold at 12:26, retests at 12:30 and confirms the half-width rejection at 12:36, beyond the producer’s noon endpoint. The user-required freshness check changes that additional example: IBL25790.75 first revisits at10:30, well before the11:55 candidate, so the later event is historical boundary reuse and is not a fresh-level positive. A read-only search of complete retained sessions found no candidate under the specifically tested first-visit break +30-minute outside hold +half-IB rejection +30-minute no-opposite-close combination; this is not a claim that every author variant has no positives.
fix: Build separate fixed boundary sets for prior VA, actual source ledges and the completed 09:30–10:30 IB. Preserve clock, scope, band/line identity and known_at for every candidate. For IB/reference highs and lows, first exact revisit ends the active line independently on each side. Keep the episode initiated on that visit alive only through its stated confirmation/invalidation. After invalidation, a later touch of the same ID cannot become a new fresh setup. Profile boundaries remain a separately sourced object rather than inheriting high/low expiry by analogy.

Find close-break and complete the named 30-minute outside hold. Slice the retest window strictly after confirmation, require approach from outside, then apply the directional rejection and inside invalidation rule to that same episode. Enforce the stated no close back inside during the30-minute retest confirmation; absence of a30-minute held inside break is a weaker test and must not substitute. Record the initial first-visit timestamp before applying any larger sweep-depth threshold.

Freeze an external next-value target and the available prior-session direction filter at setup time. Do not use a prior VA edge behind the entry as an automatically reached continuation target. A candidate next target that is an external high/low must also be fresh at selection. Do not synthesize a next-value input merely because a current prior-VA edge exists.

Measure target reach after retest confirmation until 16:00 and report it conditional on confirmed setups. Print boundary family and side separately; keep the source’s unspecified HTF-bias interpretation visible.

January30,2026 remains an illustrative later held-break/retest: break known11:56, hold12:26, retest12:30, rejection known12:36. However IBL25790.75 was consumed10:30 and the earlier episode returned inside, so the later event is ineligible as a new fresh-level setup. Keep both facts in the acceptance record.

title: Re-acceptance flips the balance bias
source: The relevant event is acceptance outside a balance followed by acceptance back inside it, then a move toward the opposite side. This differs from merely opening outside or briefly poking an edge.
finding: Fresh code now evaluates both break sides, contrary to the stale FORMULAS description. Its inside hold still checks only the re-entered edge, and target lookup is whole-window and compared with re-entry rather than confirmation. An earlier inside episode is invalidated before target.

A far-side escape is a traversal, not an inside hold. Preserve later eligible episodes after an earlier re-entry is invalidated; the source’s balance re-acceptance rule permits this profile-context reuse. This is distinct from rearming an expired session high/low.
Set bias at inside_confirmation and measure a new opposite-edge touch afterward. Stop at the defined outside invalidation; do not accept a target earlier than confirmation.

title: Traverse without acceptance, then continuation retests
source: The source says a traverse without holding inside changes how later retests are traded. It does not impose a 30-minute maximum on the entire traverse.
finding: The helper adds a total 30-minute traversal cap, scans only AM, and the scorer keeps traverse_nohold while ignoring retest_continuation. August 21 has the traversal prerequisite but its helper continuation result is false. August 26, 2026 demonstrates a valid named continuation after a41-minute traverse: first outside close known09:44, opposite outside close known10:25, retest10:25 and half-width rejection known10:28. No uninterrupted30-minute inside hold occurs.
fix: Identify an ordered close-through of the first boundary and then the other. Between them, test only whether a complete 30-minute inside acceptance occurred; remove the additional total-traverse-time cap from the source-derived row. Search subsequent crossing pairs after failed or already accepted episodes; the first upper/lower close of the entire day must not permanently determine every later traverse.

After the second crossing, search every distinct retest of either boundary from the traverse side through 16:00.
